messages.text:
Hi,

My Wingbits is no longer working. The power won't come on and I've tried
many different outlets. Can you please help me figure out why it isn't
working?

Best,
Andrew

Hi Andrew,

Sorry to hear your Wingbits has gone dark. Good call trying different outlets, since that rules out the wall sockets. When a station shows no power at all, the problem is usually the power adapter or its cable, not the station itself, so that's the first thing to check.

Please try these:

1. Unplug everything. Then firmly reseat the adapter in the wall, the cable in the adapter (if it comes apart), and the plug in the station. Connectors often work loose, especially if the unit is mounted outside or the cable has been moved.

2. Check the whole cable for kinks, cuts or crushed sections, particularly where it runs through a window, door or wall. Check the connectors for corrosion too.

3. If your station is powered over an Ethernet cable through a PoE injector, check whether the injector's light comes on. Also try a different Ethernet cable between the injector and the station if you have one.

4. If you have another power adapter whose voltage, current and plug type match what's printed on the station's label, try it. Please don't use an adapter that doesn't match the label.

If the adapter, cable or plug ever feels hot, or you notice a burning smell, unplug it right away and don't use it again.

If it still won't power on, please reply with:
• which Wingbits model you have (it's on the label on the unit)
• a clear photo of that label, including the serial number
• a photo of the label on the power adapter
• a short video of you plugging it in, showing whether any light comes on, even briefly

With those I can tell whether it's the adapter or the station itself and help you sort it out.

Best,
Hal
